target.title: fix(mattermost): cap monitor channel history namespaces
target.body:
<!--
AI-assisted: generated with Cursor / Claude Sonnet 4.6
-->

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where long-running Mattermost monitor sessions on servers with many channels or threads would accumulate an unbounded number of channel history namespaces in memory, causing the process to grow without limit for the lifetime of the connection.

`monitorMattermostProvider` maintains a `channelHistories` Map that stores per-channel/thread conversation history windows. Every distinct channel or thread that generates an event adds a new key to this Map. Each per-channel entry is already capped by `historyLimit`, but the namespace map itself had no cap: a Mattermost server with hundreds of active channels (or a bot observing many threads over hours) would keep growing the Map indefinitely.

## Why This Change Was Made

Call `evictOldHistoryKeys(channelHistories, MAX_MATTERMOST_CHANNEL_HISTORIES)` after each `createChannelHistoryWindow({...}).record()` call. This uses the SDK helper that already exists for this purpose (`openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-history`) and evicts the oldest-seen channel key when the namespace count exceeds the cap of 200.

`evictOldHistoryKeys` is added to `runtime-api.ts` alongside `createChannelHistoryWindow` since both are part of the same history management surface.

The cap value (200) is consistent with the scale of active channels in a typical Mattermost workspace and provides generous headroom while bounding memory growth.

## User Impact

Operators running OpenClaw against large Mattermost workspaces with many channels or high thread activity will no longer see the monitor process grow its `channelHistories` Map without bound over long uptimes. History for channels beyond the 200-namespace cap is evicted (oldest-first) rather than retained forever.

## Evidence

- **Unbounded declaration:** `extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor.ts:875` (pre-fix): `const channelHistories = new Map<string, HistoryEntry[]>();` — no size guard.
- **Growth path:** `recordPendingHistory()` at line 1482 calls `createChannelHistoryWindow({historyMap: channelHistories}).record(...)`, which inserts a new Map key for each previously-unseen `historyKey` (channel or thread ID).
- **Fix:** `evictOldHistoryKeys(channelHistories, MAX_MATTERMOST_CHANNEL_HISTORIES)` appended inside `recordPendingHistory()`, matching the pattern used by the Tlon cap fix (#101693).
- **Isomorphism with Tlon:** the Tlon channel history cap PR (#101693) fixed the identical structure (`messageCache = new Map` with no namespace bound). The Mattermost `channelHistories` is the same shape.
- **`evictOldHistoryKeys` contract:** evicts oldest insertion-order keys when `map.size > maxKeys`; defined in `src/auto-reply/reply/history.ts:15`, re-exported from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-history`.
- **Diff:** 4 lines across 2 files; no behaviour change below the 200-namespace threshold.
